events.title: The Tang court begins moving into the Daming Palace
events.description: Under Emperor Gaozong, the Tang imperial family began moving from the Taiji Palace into the new Daming Palace in Chang'an. It became the seat of the imperial court and the residence of Tang emperors for more than 220 years.
events.html: Under Emperor Gaozong, the Tang imperial family began moving from the Taiji Palace into the new Daming Palace in Chang'an. It became the seat of the imperial court and the residence of Tang emperors for more than 220 years.

events.title: John I of Brabant wins the Battle of Worringen
events.description: Near Cologne, Duke John I of Brabant, supported by the counts of Berg and Mark and the citizens of Cologne, defeated and captured Archbishop Siegfried of Westerburg. The victory won Limburg for Brabant, and Cologne became in effect a free city.
events.html: Near Cologne, Duke John I of Brabant, supported by the counts of Berg and Mark and the citizens of Cologne, defeated and captured Archbishop Siegfried of Westerburg. The victory won Limburg for Brabant, and Cologne became in effect a free city.

events.title: Bertrand de Got is elected Pope Clement V
events.description: The archbishop of Bordeaux was elected after a long deadlock. Clement V never went to Rome; his move to Avignon began nearly seventy years of papal residence in France.
events.html: The archbishop of Bordeaux was elected after a long deadlock. Clement V never went to Rome; his move to Avignon began nearly seventy years of papal residence in France.

events.title: June Rebellion breaks out in Paris
events.description: Republicans raised barricades after the funeral of General Lamarque. The rising was crushed the next day, and Victor Hugo later set the climax of Les Misérables on its barricades.
events.html: Republicans raised barricades after the funeral of General Lamarque. The rising was crushed the next day, and Victor Hugo later set the climax of Les Misérables on its barricades.

events.title: Express d'Orient makes its first run from Paris
events.description: Georges Nagelmackers's luxury train service left Paris for Vienna. That October it was extended towards Constantinople, and as the Orient Express it became a legend of rail travel.
events.html: Georges Nagelmackers's luxury train service left Paris for Vienna. That October it was extended towards Constantinople, and as the Orient Express it became a legend of rail travel.

events.title: Arab Revolt against Ottoman rule begins
events.description: Forces of Sharif Hussein of Mecca, led by his sons, attacked the Ottoman garrison at Medina. Backed by Britain, the revolt helped drive the Ottomans from Arabia and Syria.
events.html: Forces of Sharif Hussein of Mecca, led by his sons, attacked the Ottoman garrison at Medina. Backed by Britain, the revolt helped drive the Ottomans from Arabia and Syria.

events.title: George Marshall proposes a plan to rebuild Europe
events.description: In a speech at Harvard, the US Secretary of State offered aid to European recovery. The Marshall Plan provided some $13 billion and deepened the divide between East and West.
events.html: In a speech at Harvard, the US Secretary of State offered aid to European recovery. The Marshall Plan provided some $13 billion and deepened the divide between East and West.

events.title: Israel launches the Six-Day War
events.description: Israeli air strikes destroyed most of Egypt's air force on the ground. In six days Israel took Sinai, Gaza, the West Bank, East Jerusalem and the Golan Heights.
events.html: Israeli air strikes destroyed most of Egypt's air force on the ground. In six days Israel took Sinai, Gaza, the West Bank, East Jerusalem and the Golan Heights.

events.title: Robert F. Kennedy is shot in Los Angeles
events.description: Minutes after winning the California primary, Senator Kennedy was shot by Sirhan Sirhan at the Ambassador Hotel. He died the next day, two months after Martin Luther King's assassination.
events.html: Minutes after winning the California primary, Senator Kennedy was shot by Sirhan Sirhan at the Ambassador Hotel. He died the next day, two months after Martin Luther King's assassination.

intl.name: World Environment Day
intl.description: Established by the United Nations in 1972 and observed in over 143 countries, World Environment Day is the principal global platform for raising awareness and driving action on urgent environmental issues.
